senses.gloss: m. pl.(b. h.; preced.) virginity, token or symptom of virginity. טענת ב׳ suit of a husband against his young married wife concerning her virginity (Deut. XXII, 13 sq.).
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Yevamot 6:4:3">Y. Yeb. VI, 7ᶜ</cite> top, a. e. <he>כלו בְּתוּלֶיהָ</he> the symptoms of virginity may have disappeared by absorption. Y. Nidd. 49ᵃ bot. <he>בתולה לב׳</he> a b’thulah (virgin) as to virginity, opp. <he>לדמים</he> as to menstruation.
